doc.brief: The QToolTip class provides tool tips (balloon help) for any widget.
doc.index_brief: Tool tips (balloon help) for any widget

QFont font().brief: Returns the font used to render tooltips.

QPalette palette().brief: Returns the palette used to render tooltips.

QString text().brief: Returns the tooltip text, if a tooltip is visible, or an empty string if a tooltip is not visible.

bool isVisible().brief: Returns `true` if a tooltip is currently shown.

void hideText().brief: Hides the tool tip. This is the same as calling [showText](xref:qt:QToolTip)() with an empty string.

void setFont(const QFont &font).brief: Sets the *font* used to render tooltips.

void setPalette(const QPalette &palette).brief: Sets the *palette* used to render tooltips.

void showText(const QPoint &pos, const Q.brief: Shows *text* as a tool tip, with the global position *pos* as the point of interest.
